source.source_name: Depósito de Cuentas Anuales (Registro Mercantil) — annual accounts XBRL
source.attribution: Source: Registro Mercantil / Colegio de Registradores de España (CORPME).

access.note: Per-company fee (~EUR 9-20). No registration required for occasional access, but documents are paid. No bulk, no free API.

transport.record_path: per-company deposit ZIP (XBRL accounts + PDF docs)

pagination.note: Search by NIF or denominación, pay, retrieve one company's deposit. No enumeration of the population; no bulk.

snapshot.note: Persist the deposit ZIP; extract XBRL for figures, keep PDFs as documents.

parsing.notes: Parse XBRL with Arelle against the ES PGC taxonomy. tipo de cuentas (normal/abreviado/PYME/micro) governs which concepts exist; revenue/net_result/employees nullable for small models. Capture individual vs consolidado.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per ejercicio; map balance + P&L concepts.
mapping_rules.revenue: Importe neto de la cifra de negocios
mapping_rules.matching: Join via NIF/CIF; fall back to denominación+provincia or hoja registral.

fixture_requirements: cuentas normales (large) with full balance + P&L + audit
deposit with audit report present vs absent

live_test_plan.smoke: Not applicable without payment — do not attempt automated paid retrieval without explicit authorization.
live_test_plan.full: Behind a payment-token env gate and explicit authorization, retrieve target companies by NIF; persist ZIP; parse XBRL; normalize. Otherwise prefer a commercial aggregator for financials at scale.

blockers: Paid per company (~EUR 9-20); no bulk; no free API — not viable for whole-population ingestion at zero cost.
Reuse/redistribution of purchased documents is restricted.
Join to the open spine is weak when CIF is missing.
